name: RAWmakase
one_liner: A fast, non-destructive RAW photo developer for Linux, macOS and Windows with Lightroom-style controls.

text.why: Working on RAW photos often means a subscription app. RAWmakase opens RAW files from almost every current camera, develops them with Lightroom-style controls and exports JPEG or 16-bit TIFF.
text.take: It is non-destructive: it never writes to your original photos or Lightroom catalog.
build: White balance, exposure and tone, curves, an HSL colour mixer, three-way grading, denoise and sharpening, crop and lens corrections. It imports ratings, flags, keywords and compatible settings from a Lightroom Classic catalog without writing to the original.

who.role: Photographers who shoot RAW and want to edit without a subscription.

start.text: Download the latest version from the repository or rawmakase.com and install it.

caveat: A personal project in active development that aims for close, not exact, Lightroom parity. Sigma Foveon, Leica Monochrom and already-demosaiced linear DNGs are not supported, and spot removal and masks are experimental.

license.scope_text: Use, change and redistribute, commercially too. Keep the notice.

numbers.star_delta_unit: GitHub stars gained in the window, GH Archive events summed to as_of
